## Summary

Adds `sc-auggie-review-protocol`: a SuperClaude skill that orchestrates Auggie CLI/MCP for deep code review of PRs, local diffs, and file snapshots. Claude handles orchestration, file:line grounding, and synthesis; Auggie handles the deep-retrieval pass.

- **Explicit-trigger-only**: activated by `/sc:auggie-review`, never by conversational keywords.
- **Validated**: 3 iterations + a description-calibration pass (7/7 negatives — zero conversational firing).
- **Meta first test**: the new PostToolUse hook (`offer-pr-review.sh`) fires after this very `gh pr create` and offers `/sc:auggie-review` on the resulting PR.

## What's in this PR

| Path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `src/superclaude/skills/sc-auggie-review-protocol/SKILL.md` | 5-wave protocol (Resolve & Validate → Collect Inputs → Auggie Deep Pass → Validate & Synthesize → Post & Handoff) |
| `src/superclaude/skills/sc-auggie-review-protocol/refs/{auggie-prompts,remediation-handoff,severity-rubric}.md` | Auggie prompts, post-review handoff chain, Critical/High/Med/Low/Nit rubric |
| `src/superclaude/skills/sc-auggie-review-protocol/evals/evals.json` | Eval set used across iterations |
| `src/superclaude/commands/auggie-review.md` | `/sc:auggie-review` slash command — deterministic skill router |
| `src/superclaude/agents/auggie-reviewer.md` | Independent Claude-side reviewer agent (used in `--depth deep`) |
| `src/superclaude/hooks/scripts/offer-pr-review.sh` | PostToolUse hook fired after `gh pr create` |
| `src/superclaude/cli/install_hooks.py` | `_FRESHNESS_SCRIPTS` registry entry for verify-sync |
| `.claude/settings.json` | PostToolUse hook registration (project-local) |
| `.gitignore` | Explicit `!.claude/settings.json` exception |

## Validation history

- **iter-1**: protocol shake-down — 3 evals × 2 configs, 6 runs, 100% pass.
- **iter-2**: foregrounded Auggie pitfalls (`--output-format json` vs `--json`; markdown-fence stripping); added 5 discriminating with-skill-only assertions.
- **iter-3**: documented `--max-turns` preamble strip (`tail -n +2`); verified end-to-end clean parse against a real Auggie invocation that emitted the preamble.
- **description calibration**: 7/7 on the constraint that matters — zero false-positive firing on "review", "PR", "code review", "anti-patterns", "Auggie", "diff", "quality regressions", "bugs". Slash-command queries don't trigger via the description either (by design: routing is owned by the slash command file).

## `.claude/` convention codified

`.gitignore` now makes explicit what was implicit: the `.claude/` directory is gitignored convenience output of `make sync-dev` from `src/superclaude/`. The only allowed tracked file is `.claude/settings.json` (project-local hook + permission config — not auto-generated). If `git add` ever needs `-f` for another `.claude/*` path, that's the signal the change belongs in `src/superclaude/` instead.

## Safety properties (kept verbatim from skill)

- Never uses `gh pr review --approve` or `--request-changes` — strictly `--comment` only.
- Remediation handoff (`sc:design` → task-builder → `sc:reflect` → execute → validate) is **user-gated**; never auto-triggered.
- `/sc:reflect --type task --validate` is the mandatory final gate before any commit.

## Test plan

- [ ] Run `/sc:auggie-review <this PR number>` once merged-into-CI — meta first real-world test.
- [ ] Confirm `make verify-sync` passes on the merge commit (already green locally).
- [ ] Confirm the `offer-pr-review.sh` PostToolUse hook fires on this very `gh pr create` (visible in this session's tool stream).
- [ ] Spot-check that conversational mentions of "code review", "anti-patterns", "Auggie", etc. in unrelated chats do NOT cause the skill to fire.
